name: Higher Heights
description: Higher Heights is a film and photography studio working across fashion, luxury, automotive and sport, directed by Morgan. UK based, filming worldwide.

expertise.name: Brand films & commercials
expertise.line: Story-led films for brands, agencies and the occasional very particular private client.

expertise.name: Aerial
expertise.line: Drone and ground units shooting in tandem — one continuous move from the air to eye level.

expertise.name: Product & stills
expertise.line: Movement, up close. Macro and studio work for objects that deserve to be looked at.

expertise.name: Events & coverage
expertise.line: Ringside, backstage, after dark. Coverage that keeps the room's atmosphere intact.

expertise.name: Social cutdowns
expertise.line: Every ratio and cutdown the campaign actually needs, delivered with the master.

process.name: Brief & references
process.text: A conversation, a deck, a mood film — whatever exists. We agree what the film has to do before anyone talks about lenses.

process.name: Pre-production
process.text: Treatment, shot list, schedule, locations, permissions. The unglamorous part that decides whether the shoot day runs.

process.name: Shoot
process.text: Lean crew, deliberately. Enough hands to move fast, few enough that the room stays quiet and the subject stays comfortable.

process.name: Post & delivery
process.text: Edit, grade, sound, captions. Master plus every ratio and cutdown the campaign actually needs.
